annotations.title: Read Through the Root Surface (List-Gated Clients)

description: Run a free read without a confirmation (CO 756): catalog, inventory, bookings, your orders. Addressing, schemas and authority are exactly federation_act's. A write, a priced tool or an open-web tool is refused with not_a_read: call it through federation_act, which asks first. Returns: The inner tool's own result, or not_a_read. Example: call federation_read with arguments {"tool":"<tool>"}.

tenant_id.description: The tenant, for a branched platform tool; omit for a root tool. As federation_act.

name: federation_read
